# HW1: IMPORT DATA FROM STATISTICAL PACKAGES AND DBMS

# PART 1: IMPORT DATA FROM BUILT-IN STATISTICAL DATASETS

# 1. Load built-in datasets
library(datasets)

# 2. Import iris dataset
data(iris)

# 3. View the dataset
View(iris)

# 4. Display first 10 observations
head(iris, 10)

# 5. Display dataset structure
str(iris)

# 6. Summary statistics
summary(iris)

# 7. Number of rows and columns
nrow(iris)
ncol(iris)

# 8. Average sepal length
mean(iris$Sepal.Length)

# 9. Average sepal width
mean(iris$Sepal.Width)


# PART 2: IMPORT DATA FROM AN EXTERNAL STATISTICAL PACKAGE

# 1. Install package (run only when not installed)
if (!requireNamespace("nycflights13", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("nycflights13")
}

# 2. Load package
library(nycflights13)

# 3. Import flights dataset
data("flights", package = "nycflights13")

# 4. View dataset
View(flights)

# 5. Display first 15 observations
head(flights, 15)

# 6. Display structure
str(flights)

# 7. Summary statistics
summary(flights)

# 8. Number of observations
nrow(flights)

# 9. Number of variables
ncol(flights)

# 10. Calculate average arrival delay
mean(flights$arr_delay, na.rm = TRUE)


## IMPORTING DATA FROM DATABASE

install.packages(c("DBI", "RMariaDB", "dplyr"))

library(DBI)
library(RMariaDB)
library(dplyr)

con <- dbConnect(
  MariaDB(),
  host     = "localhost",
  port     = 3306,
  user     = "root",
  password = "",             
  dbname   = "beauty_saloon"
)

dbListTables(con)              
dbListFields(con, "employees") 

# a) read all table 
employees <- dbReadTable(con, "employees")
head(employees)
str(employees)

# b) read using SQL query
active <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT full_name, specialization, telephone, status
  FROM employees
  ORDER BY full_name
")
print(active)

# c) Read using dplyr
emp_tbl <- tbl(con, "employees")

by_spec <- emp_tbl %>%
  group_by(specialization) %>%
  summarise(abakozi = n()) %>%
  collect()
print(by_spec)

# Close connection
dbDisconnect(con)
